facts.fact: The Bank of the Republic of Burundi pilots BurundiPay, the national instant payment system, with 17 institutions live on 4 August 2026 (BRB payment systems director Nduwimana Libere).
The BRB has acceded to PAPSS and four Burundian banks are authorised to take part, according to BRB's Nduwimana Libere.

systems.owner: Bank of the Republic of Burundi
